When Manchester City was found guilty in September of breaching Premier League financial rules, the damning and unprecedented verdict left the football world reeling. An independent commission said the club had "systematically" broken rules between 2009 and 2018 by inflating sponsorship revenue to disguise secret funding of more than £830m into its football operations. Speculation is now rife about the level of punishment City will face, although the club denies any wrongdoing and has appealed against the ruling.

It was Dan Lanning's team that was left with a point on the scoreboard with a smirk as the fourth quarter wound to a close. The Ducks got the job done and walked off the field surrounded by nearly empty stands in the Horseshoe, as a crowd of over 103,000 fans had largely dispersed before the final whistle, with Oregon completely dominating the game, winning 41-28 on the road. There were some wild swings in the game, with Ohio State jumping out to an early 14-0 lead in the first quarter while the Oregon defense was left reeling. However, the Ducks went on to score 38 unanswered points,…

stories.title: How Ohio State’s Oregon disaster is historically bad for Buckeyes
stories.summary: The Buckeyes led 14-0 early against the Ducks before allowing a 38-0 run. The loss to Oregon made the wrong kind of history for Ohio State. The Buckeyes started 6-1 this year, but after quarterback Julian Sayin was injured in the win over Indiana, the Buckeyes lost on the road at USC. That losing streak was extended to two games on Saturday as the Oregon Ducks went into Columbus and rolled to a 41-22 win. Backup Buckeyes quarterback Luke Fahey threw for 360 yards and two touchdowns in the game, while Jeremiah Smith had 133 yards and two touchdowns, but it wasn't enough as they found themselves facing a 38-14 second-half deficit.

stories.title: Five takeaways from UNC's dominant road win vs. UConn
stories.summary: Entering Saturday with a pair of close losses, the UNC football team delivered by controlling UConn in a 17-point win. Here's our top five takeaways. After 60 minutes, UNC left East Hartford with its most complete performance of the 2026 season. North Carolina dominated the Huskies, 38-21 , behind a balanced offense that turned mistakes into points. The Tar Heels (5-4, 2-3 ACC) scored 14 points off two UConn turnovers, starting with Timir Hickman-Collins ' first career interception. Hickman-Collins, a sophomore from Fort Mill (S.C.), picked off Kalieb Osborne's pass and returned it 62 yards for the UNC touchdown.

stories.summary: Oregon has had a disastrous 2026 season compared to expectations. But there remains a path for the Ducks to reach the CFP. If Oregon is going to be a College Football Playoff team in 2026, it would be arguably the wildest path to the bracket ever seen. The Ducks — who have already endured three losses, their starting quarterback going down with a long-term injury and a change at defensive coordinator — got their biggest win of the season on Saturday, toppling Ohio State 41-28. stories.title: Ducks Wire MVP goes to Oregon defense vs. Ohio State
stories.summary: The entire Oregon defensive unit had a dominant day against Ohio State, earning our MVP award as a unit. Things looked bleak early on for the Ducks, as the Buckeyes raced out to a 14-0 lead in the first quarter. Neither the Oregon offense or defense looked ready to play. Then, a switch flipped. Ohio State managed zero points until garbage time, as they scored with three minutes remaining to make the final score appear closer. On fourth down conversions, the Buckeyes went 0-of-4 — a critical stat category that is imperative for a road team to come out on top in if they're going to win. The Ducks did just that.

stories.title: Ohio State sees CFP bubble burst with humbling home loss to Oregon
stories.summary: Ohio State's College Football Playoff hopes are official on life support after a humbling home loss to Oregon. This was a surreal loss that showed the Buckeyes ' increasingly narrow room for error. After taking a 14-0 lead and seeming on the verge of an impressive win against an opponent in the debut playoff rankings, their grip on the lead began to slip away after an Oregon fake punt in the second quarter. The Ducks dominated from there. By the midway mark of the third quarter, they'd reversed that deficit and taken a 17-point lead, causing a cascade of boos to rain down inside the Horseshoe.

stories.title: ‘Even With Jeremiah Smith, It’s Over’ — Ohio State’s Big Ten, CFP Hopes Hang By a Thread After Oregon Loss
stories.summary: For one quarter, everything was going according to plan. Then the bottom fell out. According to the PFN College Football Playoff Meter (FPM) , Ohio State's CFP chances cratered from 46.0% to 20.5% with the defeat. The hit to their Big Ten Championship Game odds was even steeper, tumbling from 46.9% to a measly 16.7%, as the Buckeyes now need significant help to reach Indianapolis. As for the Ducks, their CFP odds remain under 10%, largely because they still have to be flawless in their last three contests to even sniff the final bracket.

"I have a tendency to rip it really hard in the first mile and I go too fast in the first mile," Howard said. "I have been keeping in my mind to pull it back and stay the hunter. Brock Taylor sets Vanderbilt football record with five field goals vs Mississippi State
stories.summary: Brock Taylor set a Vanderbilt football record by hitting five field goals in a game against Mississippi State. The fifth field goal put the Commodores (3-6, 0-5 SEC) up, 22-14, in the fourth quarter against the Bulldogs (4-4, 2-4) in the game Nov. 7 at Davis-Wade Stadium. The previous record for most field goals in a single game was four, held by both Hawkins Golden in 1973 against Georgia and John Markham against Duke in 2000. Taylor is up to 12 field goals this season and 43 in his career, which is third all-time in Commodores history. The school record for career made field goals is held by Markham, who made 47 between 1997-00. Taylor made 18 field goals in 2024 and 13 in 2025.
